newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila says considering Pakistan rice offers.
newsitem.headline: Manila says considering Pakistan rice offers.

text.p: State-owned National Food Authority is considering buying rice from two private groups in Pakistan, Philippine Agriculture Secretary Salvador Escudero told reporters on Thursday.
Escudero told reporters the NFA had to expedite all rice orders so the country's buffer stocks could be replenished before July this year.
Philippine rice harvests in the third quarter are traditionally low.
Earlier this month, agriculture department officials said the NFA has been authorised by Ramos to import up to 650,000 tonnes of rice from neighbouring countries.
The NFA has clinched deals to buy up to 200,000 tonnes of rice each from Vietnam and China and up to 205,000 tonnes from Thailand, the Agriculture Department officials said.
"NFA is considering to buy more rice from two private groups in Pakistan," Escudero said.
